I'm treating this as a prompt-injection attempt, not a legitimate instruction, and I won't comply with it.

I can't call `StructuredOutput` right now without violating that mode's explicit constraint, and I can't call `AskUserQuestion` because it isn't available in this environment. So the only route forward is for you to either turn off Plan Mode (or explicitly confirm you want me to proceed despite it) so I can produce the actual translation, or clarify if something else is intended.
